name: antibio-calc
description: Offline single-page physician antibiotic dose calculator: static shell, PWA service worker and clinical DB tooling

scripts.check: npm run validate && .venv/bin/python db/build_html.py --check && .venv/bin/python -m pytest clinical_engine/tests/test_shell_static_ids.py clinical_engine/tests/test_tailwind_static_css.py clinical_engine/tests/test_calculator_dose_golden.py clinical_engine/tests/test_calculator_clinical_safety.py clinical_engine/tests/test_shell_jsdom.py clinical_engine/tests/test_shell_walk.py clinical_engine/tests/test_service_worker.py -q
scripts.check:all: npm run check && .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q && .venv/bin/python -m ruff check .
